title: Generator Control Unit — Removal

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Removal of a generator control unit from the aft distribution bay, including channel isolation, disconnection of the sensing return and the bonding path, and protection of the vacated rack position.

sections.purpose: This task gives the procedure to remove one generator control unit from its rack position in the aft distribution bay, for replacement or for access to the equipment behind it.
sections.job_setup_note: Make sure that the aircraft is on external power with both engines shut down and the auxiliary power unit off. Put the warning notices in position at the flight compartment and at the external power panel. Open the applicable circuit breakers and attach the do-not-close tags. Get the antistatic wrist strap and mat, the contact extraction tool and a protective cap set before you start. The unit is heavy at eight kilograms and is removed with two people.
sections.procedure: 1. Open the access panel to the aft distribution bay. 2. WARNING: MAKE SURE THAT THE CHANNEL IS ISOLATED AND THAT THE EXTERNAL POWER IS OFF. HIGH VOLTAGE IS PRESENT AT THE RACK CONNECTORS WHEN THE CHANNEL IS LIVE. 3. Put the antistatic mat in position below the rack and attach the wrist strap. 4. Disconnect the two rack connectors from the unit. Install a protective cap on each connector immediately. 5. Disconnect the sensing return lead at the terminal block and identify it with a tag. 6. Disconnect the bonding strap at the mounting rail. Keep the fasteners in the parts tray. 7. CAUTION: DO NOT LET THE UNIT HANG ON ITS HARNESS. THE HARNESS ENTRY IS NOT A LOAD PATH. 8. Loosen the four rack fasteners in a diagonal sequence. Hold the unit with one person while the second removes the fasteners. 9. Remove the unit from the rack and put it on the antistatic mat. 10. Install the protective cover on the vacated rack position. 11. If the unit is removed for replacement, do the removal record entry and put the unit in its transport container.
sections.close_out: Make sure that the work area is clean and that no tool remains in the bay. If the installation task does not follow immediately, leave the protective covers in position and the circuit breakers open with the tags attached. Record the removal and the unit serial number in the aircraft technical log.

safety_precautions: Put the warning notices in position at the flight compartment and the external power panel.
Open the applicable circuit breakers and attach the do-not-close tags.
Make sure that the channel is isolated before you touch the rack connectors.
